title: Philosophy of Occultism
author: Unknown
description: Philosophy of Occultism, a short occult treatise published by the National Institute, Masonic Temple, Chicago (the same mail-order house that issued L. H. Anderson's manuals), with the name Lillie M. Zimmermann appearing on the title pages and a chapter on 'The Beauty Sleep'. Its publisher's note describes it as treating, from the standpoint of the mystic, 'the problems which are now making such a stir in the world of thought', and the way to make life happy. In about nine chapters it discusses the hidden laws of mind and nature, the occult powers latent in human beings, thought force, mental healing, sleep and its regenerative power, health and beauty culture, and the cultivation of serenity and success. It belongs to the popular American occultism and New Thought literature of the late nineteenth and early twentieth centuries.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. One format was converted from the other (PDF from EPUB).
rights: From the curator's private collection. Publication rights for this edition are to be confirmed before public release.
